Introducing the perfect accessory for every laid-back day — a Classic Dad Cap that blends comfort and style effortlessly. This cap radiates a relaxed vibe, making it an ideal addition to casual outfits. Whether you’re heading to the beach, running errands, or enjoying a weekend barbecue, this cap will keep you looking effortlessly cool. It's designed for adults who appreciate both functionality and fashion, making it a thoughtful gift for Father’s Day, birthdays, or any casual celebration. Elevate your style and protect yourself from the sun with this versatile cap that seamlessly fits into any outfit, making it a staple in your wardrobe.

Product features
- Comfortable, unstructured body for daily wear
- 6-panel structure with eyelets for breathability
- Precurved visor with matching underbill
- Adjustable snap closure for a perfect fit
- 100% cotton fabric for softness and durability

Care instructions
- Use warm water and dish soap and clean spots off your hat. It's not necessary to soak the whole item. For hard to clean spots use a soft bristled brush.

- Use warm water and dish soap and clean spots off your hat. It's not necessary to soak the whole item. For hard to clean spots use a soft bristled brush.

- Cierre a presión ajustable para un ajuste perfecto
- 100% tejido de algodón para suavidad y durabilidad

- Usa agua tibia y jabón para platos y limpia las manchas de tu gorra. No es necesario remojar todo el artículo. Para manchas difíciles de limpiar, usa un cepillo de cerdas suaves.

- सांस लेने की क्षमता के लिए आईलेट्स के साथ 6-पैनल संरचना
- मैचिंग अंडरबिल के साथ प्री-कर्वेड विज़र
- सही फिट के लिए एडजस्टेबल स्नैप क्लोजर
- कोमलता और स्थायित्व के लिए 100% सूती कपड़े

- अपनी टोपी से धब्बों को साफ करने के लिए गर्म पानी और डिश सोप का उपयोग करें। पूरे आइटम को भिगोना आवश्यक नहीं है। कठिन दागों के लिए एक नरम ब्रिसल वाले ब्रश का उपयोग करें।
